summary: Markets are dominated by a risk-off macro tone today, with Reuters and Bloomberg flagging rising bond yields, weaker risk appetite, and oil strength tied to Iran tensions. In crypto, the clearest fresh bullish read is that Michael van de Poppe sees Bitcoin as having bottomed near a possible move toward $73,000, which he says could re-ignite altcoins; broader alt sentiment remains mixed and highly selective.
